digest.component_or_area: plan review and completion verification gates
propositions: Large ticket descriptions (>8000 characters) materially degrade plan-review latency and reduce completion-verification PASS rates, affecting <1% of historical tickets while capturing pain range
Plan review must return deterministic BLOCK with coverage.llm_ran=false before LLM invocation when ticket description exceeds configured maximum of 8000 characters
Completion verification must return validated deterministic FAIL with zero runner calls when authoritative ticket description exceeds the configured maximum
Light-bug-tier plan review must partition DET blocks to retain only blocking P4 description findings while downgrading other DET blocks to advisory
AC-count and file-impact P4 signals must remain advisory; description-size is the only blocking P4 signal
Configuration must enforce positive integer validation and fail-fast on invalid [verify] settings rather than silently defaulting
